Analysis: Hypothesis 2 is favored because it presents a mechanistic model that, while still needing refinement in specifying key molecular players (lactate receptors and cytokines), outlines a pathway with measurable immunometabolic endpoints. This makes it easier to test using advanced multi‐omics and targeted interventions. In contrast, Hypothesis 1, though highly novel in integrating m6A-mediated RNA stabilization and epigenetic reprogramming via CRISPR-dCas9 tools, raises concerns regarding off-target effects and added complexity in both validation and safety. Overall, Hypothesis 2 strikes a better balance between novelty, plausibility, testability, and safety.
